How it works

Three steps.

  1. Enter your idea

    A topic, a sale, an event or news — plus your business name and platforms.

  2. Pick a tone and goal

    Professional, casual, humorous, inspiring or educational; engagement, awareness, leads, sales or education.

  3. Post it

    Copy each post into its platform.

ⓘ Posting is up to you. The tool writes the posts; it doesn't connect to your accounts or post for you.

FAQ

Common questions.

Which platforms does it write for?
Any you name — LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and X are the most common.
Does it post or schedule for me?
No. Copy each post into the platform, or into the scheduler you already use.
Is what I enter stored?
No. What you enter is used to write your result and isn't kept afterward. The only things Workblox Business saves are your business profile and, if you use it, your Contacts list. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Social Media Generator is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
